# Café visits 2025

Places we tried this year, in order.

## Winter

- January, Prague, small roastery near the river: espresso was sour, the cake was great. Second espresso with a different bean was better.
- February, Brno: friendly staff, espresso fine, too loud to talk.
- February, Vienna: classic coffee house, espresso came with a glass of water, nice tradition. We stayed two hours.

## Spring

- March, Olomouc: tiny place, only two tables, the espresso tonic was a surprise.
- April, Lisbon: espresso at the counter for one euro, every corner has one.
- May, Prague: new place in the old printing house, espresso too bitter, filter coffee good.

## Summer

- June, Berlin: three cafés in one day, the second had the best espresso of the year.
- July, by the lake: no espresso, only instant coffee, still nice view.
- August, Kraków: espresso and a cheesecake, both very good.

## Autumn

- September, Prague: barista course, learned to taste espresso side by side.
- October, Ostrava: roastery tour, espresso blend tasting.
- November, home: we bought our own machine, so fewer visits.

Next year: write down the beans, not only the places.
